description:
FOUND s504 (Fable, 2026-10-02) attributing the full companion run`s movers (#2389).  mro/method_caching_utf8.t went XDIFF 21/7 -> DIFF 17/4 at bd0c38e3 (s497b merged; attribution table ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s504/attrib/table.txt): t/mro/method_caching_utf8.t:53 `undef %{MC...::B...::}` aborts its form with "Can`t use string (...) as a HASH ref while \"strict refs\" in use".

REPRODUCER ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s504/review/st1.pl (ASCII; perl 5.40.3 vs main b7ec0093):
    use strict; package Foo; sub f { 1 } sub g { 2 } package main;
    keys %{Foo::}            perl: f g            PCL: DIES strict refs
    keys %Foo::              perl: f g            PCL: f g      (the unbraced spelling is right)
    ${Foo::}{h} = sub { 3 }  perl: Foo->h is 3    PCL: no method (silent)
    undef %{Foo::}           perl: f gone         PCL: DIES strict refs; f still there

CAUSE (read, not yet located in code): the braced form `%{NAME::}` reaches the deref-block path with a BAREWORD body and is lowered as the string "Foo" used as a hash ref -- a symbolic reference -- instead of as the stash `%Foo::`.  In perl a bareword ending in `::` inside `%{...}` / `${...}{k}` / `*{...}` names the STASH (or the glob), under strict too.  The die is the wrong half of #2103`s enforcement meeting this pre-existing mis-parse; s497b is right to enforce strict refs on a real string.

FIX SHAPE (rule 11: normalise into the existing path): the brace body `NAME::` (a Word ending in `::`, nothing else) is the unbraced `%NAME::` / `$NAME::{k}` -- rewrite it where the brace-deref body is classified, so every sigil goes through the stash path that already works.  Probe the breaking cases first: `%{"Foo::"}` (a real string: symbolic, dies under strict in perl too), `%{Foo::Bar::}`, `*{Foo::}`, `${Foo::}{k}` assignment (the #1664 typeglob-model question: a code ref stored into a stash slot must become the method), a non-ASCII name (the utf8 file).  The stash WRITE half (`${Foo::}{h} = sub {...}` installs a method; `undef %{Foo::}` removes them) is #1664`s model -- size it separately; the READ half and the no-die half are this task.

BAR: st1.pl rows 1 and 4 stop dying; mro/method_caching_utf8.t back to at least 21/7; mro/method_caching.t (the ASCII twin) re-measured; guard rows.

BOOKKEEPING s504: the snapshot row of mro/method_caching_utf8.t is NOT spliced down (a regression is fixed, not blessed): every full companion run reports -4 until this is fixed.
subject: The BRACED stash spelling `%{Foo::}` / `${Foo::}{name}` / `undef %{Foo::}` is compiled as a symbolic deref of the STRING "Foo": under `use strict` it DIES "Can`t use string ("Foo") as a HASH ref" since s497b (#2103 strict refs), before that it was silently empty -- `%Foo::` (unbraced) works; mro/method_caching_utf8.t 21/7 -> 17/4
